svg.text: Developer journey — the auth check names the missing
Scenario: the auth check detects and normalizes the GitLab host from the remote

g.text: Given a self-hosted GitLab project with the tools installed but no
A throwaway project whose remote points at a self-hosted GitLab host — a company running its
own GitLab — with gum, glow and glab installed but no sign-in yet. The card shows the
Then the check reads the self-hosted GitLab host straight from the
CI mode takes the non-interactive path: "GitLab authentication required", naming the exact
self-hosted host it read from the remote. The test also checks the command failed and named
When the same project instead uses an SSH-style gitlabssh remote
The origin is switched to an SSH-style gitlabssh.* URL — the address a self-hosted GitLab
gives out for SSH clones. The card shows the new remote.
Then the check turns it back into the gitlab API host
The gitlabssh.* remote is turned back into its gitlab.* API host: the message names
gitlab.selfhosted-corp.example and never the ssh name. The test also checks the command
failed, named that host, and never printed "gitlabssh".
